proofDiscipline: Every new initialized/qualified message witness contains exact scalar header alongside full entity hash.

Header-only ancestry matches the protected header and hash identity; it makes no claim of recomputing irrelevant ancestor body hash. Actual selected/modified/evidence targets still recompute full proof.
Header-only dependencies may not be affected by persistence or changed by reducers. Node compares complete ancestor rows unchanged after C.

Old-witness fallback fully verifies one entity at a time, retains only header, and counts all canonical bytes in the finite ancestry-work allowance while sharing metadata/receipt/record budget. No read-time proof writes.
limitations: Compatibility fallback is measurably more expensive than protected headers. No free/per-ancestor reset metadata budget.
Default Native check exercises new witnesses; optional explicit old source adds genuine historical producer qualification without shipping historical Git dependency.
